responsibilities: Design, build, and maintain orchestration workflows using Airflow.
Develop and optimize curated and serving-layer models using dbt.
Implement data transformations such as cleaning, deduplication, patterns, and schema harmonization.
Build dimensional models, marts, and KPI logic for reporting and advanced analytics.
Define and maintain KPI definitions, business glossary standards, and semantic consistency across data products.
Configure and optimize datasets in BigQuery for analytical workloads.
Implement data quality and governance controls, including automated tests, lineage validation, and metadata standards.
Establish and improve end-to-end testing frameworks for pipelines and transformations.
Partner with upstream and downstream teams to ensure reliable, well-documented, high-quality data delivery.
Support BI, analytics, and data science teams with trusted datasets and reusable data assets.

evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: Implement data quality and governance controls, including automated tests, lineage validation, and metadata standards.
evidence.velocity_vs_rigour_explanation: Automated tests, lineage validation, governance controls and end-to-end testing frameworks dominate; there is no speed or shipping language anywhere.
evidence.domain_risk: The bTV Media Group is a leading source of information on the Bulgarian market with a high level of trust among viewers.
evidence.domain_risk_explanation: Media analytics at national scale, but the JD names no financial reporting, compliance or regulatory consequence.
evidence.data_team_maturity: We are looking for a Lead Analytics Engineer to help build and scale a modern data platform.
evidence.data_team_maturity_explanation: BI, analytics and data science teams already exist to support, but the platform itself is still being built and scaled.
evidence.jd_authorship: Implement data transformations such as cleaning, deduplication, patterns, and schema harmonization.
evidence.jd_authorship_explanation: Every bullet names the tool and the specific artefact — Airflow workflows, dbt serving-layer models, BigQuery datasets, lineage validation.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation: Support BI, analytics, and data science teams with trusted datasets and reusable data assets.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: The named consumers are all inside the data function: BI, analytics and data science teams.
evidence.autonomy_level: Define and maintain KPI definitions, business glossary standards, and semantic consistency across data products.
evidence.autonomy_level_explanation: The role defines the KPI logic, glossary and governance standards for the whole platform, not scoped deliverables.
evidence.ai_role: establish quality and governance standards that enable trusted analytics and downstream AI/ML use cases
evidence.ai_role_explanation: The candidate builds the modelled, governed data that downstream AI/ML use cases consume.
evidence.testing_framing: Establish and improve end-to-end testing frameworks for pipelines and transformations.
evidence.testing_framing_explanation: The candidate establishes the testing framework itself, a responsibility bullet rather than a tool in a skills list.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing: Partner with upstream and downstream teams to ensure reliable, well-documented, high-quality data delivery.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing_explanation: Trust and quality language recurs from the role summary through to the final bullets, so the fear is untrusted data reaching analytics consumers.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix: help build and scale a modern data platform
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix_explanation: The platform is being built, with design and establish verbs across orchestration, models, governance and testing.
evidence.loss_aversion: "establish quality and governance standards that enable trusted analytics" — trust in analytics is named as the purpose of the governance work.
